texts.zh:
将环绕[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
texts.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point where it now has its own appreciable level of gravitational attraction. This newly-created moon has since settled into a stable orbit.

Access to [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]'s surface is much easier without the hazardous orbital debris, and we no longer have to worry about its potential entry into the atmosphere. Moreover, our engineers are confident that this new moon can support its own mining station.
